spfProposal.title: Suggested SPF record
spfProposal.create: Add this TXT record to authorize the domain's MX hosts. Make sure the MX records point to this server, and include any other services that send mail for the domain.
spfProposal.update: Replace the existing SPF TXT record with this value to authorize the domain's MX hosts. Make sure the MX records point to this server. Existing senders and policy are preserved; review any intentional exclusions before publishing.
spfProposal.unchanged: The current SPF record already authorizes this server.
spfProposal.review: Review the current SPF records and the reported issue before making changes. A replacement cannot be safely suggested.
spfProposal.unavailable: A suggestion is unavailable until the DNS records can be checked.
spfProposal.mxPresent: The record already includes MX authorization. Check that the MX hosts resolve to this server and that earlier SPF mechanisms do not reject it.
